name: Derrick Dewayne Ruffin
bio: My name is Derrick Dewayne Ruffin, and I was born on February 26, 1994, in Jackson, Tennessee. I am proudly married to my beautiful wife, Brie-ana, and together we are raising three wonderful daughters — Alayah (9), Aryah (6), and Skye (1). Family is the foundation of everything I do, and they motivate me to continuously grow both personally and professionally.

I am currently serving in the United States Air Force, stationed at Eglin Air Force Base in Florida. My military career has provided me with invaluable leadership experience, discipline, and a strong sense of purpose. Through my service, I have had the privilege of working in the medical field as a certified Pharmacy Technician, where I have made meaningful contributions to the health and well-being of thousands of military beneficiaries.

Academically, I am pursuing a Master of Science in Computer Information Systems at the Florida Institute of Technology, with an expected graduation in 2026. My academic and professional goals are aligned with my aspiration to commission as an officer in either the Intelligence or Cyber Warfare career fields.

Outside of work and school, I enjoy spending quality time with my family, listening to music, reading, hitting the gym, and playing sports. My long-term dream is to work at Nike in their technology department.
